data.body: Implemented per plan: _is_full_sha form check runs before any Gerrit request; malformed/abbreviated --revision gets a distinct exit-2 refusal naming git rev-parse HEAD, no staleness wording. Tests: abbreviated test asserts new wording; new parametrized malformed case (non-hex, 41 chars, empty, HEAD) asserts no Gerrit request; stale test now uses two full SHAs. 27 tests pass; make lint + make typecheck pass. Pushed as Gerrit 3209 (commit b5b2aaa54434e09e8d372673eaee7704c5f8de6e).
